articles.abstract_en: We design a laboratory experiment to identify whether a preference for randomisation defines a stable type across different choice environments. In games and individual decisions, subjects face 20 simultaneous repetitions of the same choice. Subjects can randomise by making different choices across the repetitions. We find that randomisation does define a type that is predictable across domains. A sizeable fraction of individuals randomise in all domains, even in questions that offer a stochastically dominant option. For some mixers, dominated randomisation is responsive to intervention. We explore theoretical foundations for mixing, and find that most preference-based models are unable to accommodate our results.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们设计了一个实验室实验，以识别在不同选择环境中，对随机化的偏好是否定义了一种稳定的类型。在博弈和个体决策中，受试者面临20次相同选择的重复。受试者可以通过在不同重复中做出不同选择来进行随机化。我们发现，随机化确实定义了一种在领域间可预测的类型。相当大比例的个体在所有领域都进行随机化，即使在提供随机占优选项的问题中也是如此。对于某些混合者，占优随机化对干预有反应。我们探索了混合的理论基础，并发现大多数基于偏好的模型无法容纳我们的结果。

articles.title_en: Partitioned Pricing and Collusion on Surcharges
articles.title_cn: 分项定价与附加费合谋
articles.abstract_en: Partitioned pricing is a pricing practice that divides the price of a product into a base price and one or more mandatory surcharges. This paper develops a theory of partitioned pricing using a duopoly model where the owner of each firm determines the surcharge, but delegates the setting of the base price to a manager. In equilibrium, both firms choose partitioned pricing over the conventional all-inclusive pricing. Moreover, partitioned pricing leads to higher full prices and larger profits than all-inclusive pricing. Most surprisingly, collusion on surcharges without any coordination on base prices is as profitable as collusion on all-inclusive prices.
articles.abstract_cn: 分项定价是一种将产品价格划分为基础价格和一项或多项强制性附加费的定价做法。本文利用一个双寡头模型发展了分项定价理论，在该模型中，每家企业的所有者决定附加费，但将基础价格的设定委托给经理。在均衡状态下，两家企业都选择分项定价而非传统的全包定价。此外，分项定价导致比全包定价更高的全价和更大的利润。最令人惊讶的是，在没有任何基础价格协调的情况下，对附加费的合谋与对全包价格的合谋一样有利可图。

articles.title_en: Does Homeownership Reduce Crime? A Radical Housing Reform from the UK
articles.title_cn: 自有住房能否减少犯罪？来自英国的一项激进住房改革
articles.abstract_en: ‘Right to Buy’, a large-scale natural experiment whereby incumbent tenants in public housing could buy properties at heavily subsidised prices, increased the United Kingdom homeownership rate by over 10 percentage points between its 1980 introduction and the 1990s. This paper studies the impact of this reform on crime by leveraging exogenous variation in eligibility for the policy. Results show that Right to Buy generated significant property crime reductions. Behavioural changes of incumbent tenants and renovation of public properties were the main drivers of this crime reduction. This is evidence of a novel means by which subsidised homeownership and housing policy can reduce criminality.
articles.abstract_cn: “购买权”是一项大规模自然实验，公共住房的现有租户可以以高额补贴价格购买房产，在1980年引入至1990年间，英国自有住房率提高了超过10个百分点。本文通过利用政策资格的外生变化，研究了这项改革对犯罪的影响。结果表明，“购买权”显著减少了财产犯罪。现有租户的行为变化和公共房产的翻新是犯罪减少的主要驱动因素。这为补贴性自有住房和住房政策可以减少犯罪提供了一种新途径的证据。

articles.title_en: Gender Differences in Reference Letters: Evidence from the Economics Job Market
articles.title_cn: 推荐信中的性别差异：来自经济学就业市场的证据
articles.abstract_en: Academia, and economics in particular, faces increased scrutiny because of gender imbalance. This paper studies the job market for entry-level faculty positions. We employ machine learning methods to analyse gendered patterns in the text of 12,000 reference letters written in support of over 3,700 candidates. Using both supervised and unsupervised techniques, we document widespread differences in the attributes emphasised. Women are systematically more likely to be described using ‘grindstone’ terms and at times less likely to be praised for their ability. Using information on initial placement, we highlight the implications of these gendered descriptors for the quality of academic placement.
articles.abstract_cn: 学术界，尤其是经济学领域，因性别失衡而面临越来越多的审视。本文研究了初级教职岗位的就业市场。我们采用机器学习方法分析了超过3,700名候选人的12,000封推荐信文本中的性别模式。通过监督和无监督技术，我们记录了所强调特质上的广泛差异。女性更系统性地被描述为使用‘磨盘’类术语，有时较少因能力而受到赞扬。利用初始就业信息，我们强调了这些性别描述词对学术就业质量的影响。

articles.title_en: Trade-Offs of Attending Better Schools: Achievement, Self-Perceptions and Educational Trajectories
articles.title_cn: 就读更好学校的权衡：学业成就、自我认知与教育轨迹
articles.abstract_en: This paper estimates the impacts of attending better middle schools on the test scores, on-time graduation, self-reported socio-emotional skills, aspirations and high school track choices of marginally admitted students. A regression discontinuity design comparing students just above and below the admission threshold to higher-achieving middle schools in Mexico shows some modest gains on externally graded tests, but adverse effects on grade point average and on-time graduation. By the end of middle school, marginally admitted students feel academically inferior to their peers, obtain worse scores on measures of conscientiousness, and are more likely to shift their aspirations and subsequent schooling choices from academic to vocational programmes. The results are consistent with the hypothesis that unfavourable peer comparisons, stemming from direct observation or subjective teacher assessments, can be sufficiently important to affect students’ educational trajectories.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文估计了就读更好的中学对边缘录取学生的考试成绩、按时毕业、自我报告的社会情感技能、抱负和高中轨道选择的影响。一项回归不连续设计比较了墨西哥更高成就中学录取分数线上下附近的学生，结果显示在外部评分测试中有些适度收益，但对平均绩点和按时毕业有不利影响。到中学结束时，边缘录取学生感到在学业上不如同龄人，在尽责性测量上得分更差，并且更可能将他们的抱负和后续教育选择从学术转向职业项目。结果与以下假设一致：不利的同龄人比较，源于直接观察或主观教师评估，可能足以影响学生的教育轨迹。

articles.title_en: Effects and Mechanisms of CEO Quality in Public Education
articles.title_cn: 公立教育中CEO质量的影响与机制
articles.abstract_en: ‘CEOs’ of public schools in many countries have authority and responsibilities that can greatly affect the quality of schooling. This paper estimates the impact of CEOs on student outcomes in Israeli elementary schools. We estimate CEO quality in two ways—once using schools that do not switch CEOs and once using schools that do. We show that switches are exogenous and are not correlated with potential outcomes. CEO quality positively affects students’ test scores and behavioural outcomes, with pronounced effects for disadvantaged schools. Potential mechanisms show that high-quality CEOs lead to improvements in school priorities, working procedures and violence reduction.
articles.abstract_cn: 在许多国家，公立学校的‘CEO’拥有极大的权力和责任，这些权力和责任可能对教育质量产生重大影响。本文估算了以色列小学中CEO对学生成绩的影响。我们通过两种方式估算CEO质量——一种使用未更换CEO的学校，另一种使用更换CEO的学校。我们表明，更换CEO是外生的，且与潜在结果不相关。CEO质量对学生考试成绩和行为结果产生积极影响，对弱势学校的影响尤为显著。潜在机制表明，高质量的CEO能够改善学校优先事项、工作流程并减少暴力。

articles.title_en: Do Conditional Cash Transfers Improve Economic Outcomes in the Next Generation? Evidence from Mexico
articles.title_cn: 有条件现金转移支付能否改善下一代的经济成果？来自墨西哥的证据
articles.abstract_en: Conditional cash transfer programmes have spread to over 60 countries in the past two decades, but little is known about their long-term effects. We estimate the lasting impact of childhood exposure to the Mexico’s flagship programme Progresa by leveraging the age structure of benefits and geographic variation in early programme penetration nationwide. Childhood exposure improves women’s outcomes in early adulthood with increases in educational attainment, geographic mobility, labour market performance and household living standards. For men, effects are smaller and more difficult to distinguish from spatial convergence.
articles.abstract_cn: 在过去二十年中，有条件现金转移支付项目已扩展到超过60个国家，但对其长期影响知之甚少。我们利用福利的年龄结构和全国范围内早期项目渗透的地理差异，估计了儿童时期接触墨西哥旗舰项目Progresa的持久影响。儿童时期的接触改善了女性成年早期的成果，包括教育程度、地理流动性、劳动力市场表现和家庭生活水平的提高。对于男性而言，影响较小且更难与空间趋同区分开来。

articles.title_en: A Behavioural Theory of Discrimination in Policing
articles.abstract_en: A large economic literature studies whether racial disparities in policing are explained by animus or by beliefs about group crime rates. But what if these beliefs are incorrect? We analyse a model where officers form beliefs using crime statistics, but do not properly account for the fact that they will detect more crime in more heavily policed communities. This creates a feedback loop where officers over-police groups that they (incorrectly) believe exhibit high crime rates. This inferential mistake can exacerbate discrimination even among officers with no animus and who sincerely believe that disparities are driven by real differences in crime rates.
articles.abstract_cn: 大量经济学文献研究警务中的种族差异是由敌意还是对群体犯罪率的信念所解释。但如果这些信念是错误的呢？我们分析了一个模型，其中警官利用犯罪统计形成信念，但没有适当考虑他们将在警务更密集的社区发现更多犯罪这一事实。这创造了一个反馈循环，警官过度监管他们（错误地）认为犯罪率高的群体。这种推断错误即使在那些没有敌意且真诚相信差异是由犯罪率真实差异驱动的警官中，也可能加剧歧视。

articles.abstract_en: We provide new evidence on motivations for voluntary contributions to public goods in a natural setting. Using natural language processing on users’ Twitter posts, we measure revealed sentiment changes before and after making a donation to Wikipedia. We find strong evidence that sentiment improves in the hour and minutes directly before contributing, which we call ‘preheating’. Results are robust to alternative fixed effects and approaches to inference and supported by a complementary online experiment with randomised mood inducement among Twitter users. Preheating suggests that affective states influence giving in addition to reward-seeking, utility-maximising behaviour that has been documented in other contexts.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们提供了在自然环境中自愿贡献公共物品动机的新证据。通过对用户在Twitter上的帖子进行自然语言处理，我们测量了在向维基百科捐款前后揭示的情绪变化。我们发现强有力的证据表明，在直接贡献前的一小时和几分钟内，情绪有所改善，我们称之为“预热”。结果对于替代固定效应和推断方法具有稳健性，并得到了一项在Twitter用户中进行随机情绪诱导的补充在线实验的支持。预热表明，情感状态影响给予行为，此外还有在其他情境中记录到的寻求奖励、效用最大化的行为。

excluded_items.title_en: Correction to: Sentiments and Economic Activity: Evidence from US States
